description.plain:
Product Description

A statement cabinet knob inspired by the tubular interiors trend, ALVA is bound to round off your modern kitchen design or sleek sideboard upcycle.

We’ve made buying and installing nice and simple, as all of our individually-sold knobs come equipped with enough M4, 25mm machine screws.

Dimensions

Diameter

30mm / 1.18"

Projection

30mm / 1.18"

Base Diameter

15mm / 0.59"

Screw Thread

M4 / 4mm / 0.16"

Download a product dimension spec sheet here.

 

 

Installation

Each knob comes with M4, 25mm machine screws and is simple to install. If your furniture or door already has a knob or handle on it, you may be able to unscrew the current one and replace it using the existing screw. If not, you will need to drill a small hole (or holes) in your door or furniture and tighten with a Philips screwdriver.

Materials, Finish & Care

Solid brass with clear matte coating.

Like all natural materials, brass will age over time. The clear matte lacquer coating on our products will postpone the aging process, but will not prevent it completely. Avoid exposing your brass hardware to abrasive cleaning solutions — warm water and soap will do the job.

products.title: DESIGN3768 T-Bar Cabinet Knobs for Vintage Kitchen | 2.2" Length

description.plain:
About This Item

1. Ornate Vintage Single-Hole T-Bar Cabinet Knobs – European-Inspired Finial Details with a Decorative Trumpet Base

These Ornate Vintage Single-Hole T-Bar Cabinet Knobs combine a classic horizontal crossbar with decorative finial-style end accents and a gracefully flared trumpet pedestal base. The sculpted details and balanced proportions bring European-inspired elegance, vintage character, and a handcrafted look to kitchen cabinets, drawers, and furniture.

Designed to complement Classic Elegance, Traditional, Rustic Modern, and Transitional interiors, these decorative T-bar cabinet knobs offer a versatile selection of finishes. Choose Oil Rubbed Bronze for rich, aged character, Champagne Bronze for warm understated elegance, Brushed Gold or Brushed Brass for refined golden accents, Matte Black for dramatic contrast, Brushed Satin Nickel for a softer contemporary finish, or Antique Brass for timeless vintage appeal.

2. Where to Use These Single-Hole Vintage T-Bar Cabinet Knobs

With their decorative end details and practical crossbar grip, these single-hole T-bar knobs are suitable for a variety of cabinetry and furniture projects:

  • Traditional kitchen drawers, pantry doors, and island cabinets

  • Bathroom vanities, medicine cabinets, and linen closets

  • Antique-style dressers, chests of drawers, and nightstands

  • Sideboards, credenzas, and home office desk drawers

  • Classic Elegance, Traditional, Rustic Modern, and Transitional interiors

Their European-inspired detailing makes them an attractive finishing touch for both classic cabinetry and furniture renovation projects.

3. Design Features & Everyday Benefits

  • Decorative Finial Ends: Layered end accents add dimension and ornamental character to the horizontal crossbar, creating a distinctive vintage-inspired appearance.

  • Comfortable T-Bar Grip: The 2.2" (56 mm) crossbar provides a wider gripping area than a traditional round knob, offering convenient finger placement and leverage when opening drawers and cabinet doors.

  • Flared Trumpet Pedestal Base: The sculpted base creates a graceful transition between the crossbar and cabinet surface, adding visual depth and a refined architectural detail.

  • Durable Zinc Alloy Construction: Precision-cast zinc alloy provides a solid feel and dependable functionality for everyday cabinet use.

  • Protective Electroplated Finish: A multi-layer electroplated finish with a clear protective coating helps protect the hardware surface during regular use.

  • Tested for 50,000+ Pull Cycles: Tested to help support reliable performance through repeated everyday opening and closing.

  • Passed 72-Hour Salt Spray Testing: Helps evaluate the finish's resistance to corrosion under controlled test conditions.

  • Versatile Vintage Styling: The ornamental finial details and trumpet-shaped base complement Classic Elegance, Traditional, Rustic Modern, and Transitional cabinetry.

4. How to Choose the Right Size

Before ordering, check your existing mounting hole, cabinet thickness, and available screw length to ensure compatibility.

  • Installation Type: Single-hole installation for cabinet doors and drawer fronts.

  • Overall Length: 2.2" (56 mm)

  • Height / Projection: 0.75" (19 mm)

  • Base Diameter: 0.75" (19 mm)

  • Included Screws: 1" (25 mm) and 1.77" (45 mm) screws for different cabinet thicknesses, subject to compatibility.

Replacing Existing Knobs: Remove your existing single-hole knob and check that the mounting hole and cabinet thickness are compatible with the new knob and included screws before installation.

Installing New Knobs: Mark and drill one mounting hole in the cabinet door or drawer front. Check the positioning and alignment before securing the knob.

5. Common Cabinet Hardware Problems Solved

  • Small Round Knobs Are Difficult to Grip: The 2.2" horizontal crossbar provides a wider gripping area and more convenient leverage for everyday opening and closing.

  • Plain Cabinet Hardware Lacks Decorative Character: Finial-style end details and the flared trumpet base introduce vintage-inspired architectural detail.

  • Ordinary Knobs Feel Too Simple for Traditional Interiors: The ornate silhouette adds a distinctive finishing touch to Classic Elegance, Traditional, and vintage-inspired cabinetry.

  • Concerns About Hardware Durability: Solid zinc alloy construction provides a substantial feel, while testing for 50,000+ pull cycles helps demonstrate durability under repeated everyday use.

  • Finish Durability Is a Concern: The protective electroplated finish is evaluated through 72-hour salt spray testing to help assess corrosion resistance.

  • Hardware Replacement Should Be Simple: The standard single-screw design allows convenient DIY installation with basic hand tools when the mounting hole and screw length are compatible.

6. Technical Details & Installation

  • Design: Vintage T-bar crossbar with decorative finial ends and flared trumpet pedestal base

  • Material: Zinc alloy

  • Available Finishes: Oil Rubbed Bronze, Champagne Bronze, Brushed Gold, Brushed Brass, Matte Black, Brushed Satin Nickel, Antique Brass

  • Overall Length: 2.2" (56 mm)

  • Height / Projection: 0.75" (19 mm)

  • Base Diameter: 0.75" (19 mm)

  • Installation Type: Single-hole mounting

  • Included Screws: 1" (25 mm) and 1.77" (45 mm)

  • Durability Testing: 50,000+ pull cycle testing

  • Finish Testing: 72-hour salt spray testing

For proper installation, select the screw length that matches your cabinet thickness. Tighten securely with a hand tool, avoiding excessive force that could damage the cabinet surface or hardware.

7. Amerdeco Brand Assurance

Amerdeco is committed to reliable cabinet hardware, practical installation, and lasting style. If a quality issue occurs, our 120-day replacement or resolution policy helps you address the problem with confidence.

Vintage-style Hardware

  • Classic & Traditional
  • Timeline Style:   Timeless classic style - Early 20th Century, up to Modern style interiors
  • Made of genuine glass - Black color glass
  • Silver pan-head screw comes thru glass knob & includes a square nut for fastening
  • May shorten the thru-bolt for accommodation of the material thickness
  • Available in  1",  1-1/4",  &  1-1/2"  knob sizes
  • For matching black glass pulls   See here
  • Product Description
  • Specs

  • A classic & original-style fluted glass cabinet knob in a black color with a silver pan head thru-bolt. This reproduction of the classic glass knob has been a perennial favorite since the early 20th century on furniture & cabinets of all kinds & is great for use in the kitchen, bathroom, bedroom, & everywhere else in the home. The silver bolt is inserted from the front through the head of the knob, & comes with a square nut for the back. The bolt is smooth-headed & nickel-plated, just as in the old days. Add some character to your home with these very classic & stylish glass knobs. Available in  1",  1-1/4",  &  1-1/2" knob sizes. For matching black glass pulls  See here.


    Use only hand tools to install glass knobs on your cabinets. Power tools (or even wrenches) may cause damage to the thread or to the knobs.

    Insert bolt through head of knob. To tighten, hand turn only the nut on the back of the screw (this is one reason that the heads of the screws are smooth on top and do not have a slot.) Do not turn the knob itself as it may cause breakage. Tighten carefully but do not over-tighten - remember they are made of glass & are by their nature, fragile.

    We will not replace broken knobs due to over tightening or mishandling.


    Hardwick & Sons is pleased to offer vintage-style hardware for the many people who desire to fashion their homes with charm, quality, & style. The traditional-style hardware that we showcase are true & faithful reproductions of classic hardware pieces found in the many homes from across America throughout the past century.
